report.summary: Detector fired on large SELL submissions and BUY fills followed by SELL cancels. The tape shows a registered market maker on SYN.A re-quoting a symmetric two-sided pair of 2755 (its typical size, about 1.1x depth) every 2-3 seconds, with both sides cancelled together. BUY orders were executing before any opposite-side trade. No one-sided resting order, no favourable move with reversion, no public event. Feature (a) and feature (b) are both absent and market making is supported.

response.final_text:
**Proposed disposition:** CLOSE_FP, confidence 0.90. It is recorded as PROPOSED, case C-A-261026-0001, and a human analyst decides.

**The three facts that drove it:**
1. T-X1026-01 is a registered market maker on SYN.A. The tape shows symmetric BUY and SELL quotes of 2755, its typical order size and about 1.1 times depth. The two sides are cancelled together and re-quoted every 2–3 seconds. Cancel symmetry is 0.989.
2. The BUY orders were genuinely executing. 1278 of the 2782 same-side fill quantity came before any opposite-side trade. The price move was 0.5 ticks with no reversion. There was no one-sided resting order, so I found neither core spoofing feature.
3. There were no market events or risk events in the window. The order-to-trade ratio was 16.2 against the trader's typical 40. The trader has no prior alerts in 90 days.

**What would change my mind:** evidence that the SELL side stayed resting on its own while the BUY fills happened, or a favourable price move that reverted after the cancels. Registration that doesn't cover this desk or session would also change it.
